Wj.bar_b_note: The blue-grey translucent panel fits the UI direction, but the hints use small keyboard-style glyphs instead of teal controller prompts, and the world behind is a murky, low-value rainy night with no light or atmosphere to carry it.

Am.bar_b_note: B's timber frame, brace, cap and stone footing start to read as a build piece, but the infill is still a flat untextured beige card and the flat painted sky and pale untextured rock keep it below Palworld base-building finish.

Tk.bar_b_note: The naturalistic fur bear carries it at Palworld creature finish, though the faint-end pose (sitting upright facing camera) and dim arcs on B weaken it.

Cy.bar_b_note: A clear, appealing elder villager with readable eyes, warm earthy Meadows palette and a strong silhouette; its rounder cartoon face is a step more stylised than the naturalistic creatures but still sits in the same game.

Ie.bar_b_note: A low dark navy quilled mass whose blue streaks barely separate from the coat, with a face that is lost at small size and a height that only matches the trainer, so it lacks the high-contrast read of a Palworld creature.

No.bar_b_note: A's dark indigo wolf with lighter streaks matches the owner bar and carries it, while B's washed lavender coat and both sides' legs-up faint poses (an upturned black-and-white blob) sink the later frames.

Kt.bar_b_note: A's bristly tawny boar is close to on-style but floats above its detached shadow in faint mid; B's smooth terracotta clay body with moss blobs reads as a toy, far off the naturalistic style bar.

Ws.bar_b_note: The fur bear model matches the owner's Stormursa bar, but the arcs are violet strokes rather than emissive pops and the faint end sits upright instead of collapsing.

top_changes.change: Make storm arcs/veins a thin, high-intensity emissive (white-violet core, bloom) on a darker coat for Stormursa, the quilled creature and Tanglevolt, so they pop rather than read as painted violet strokes

Author grounded faint poses: bears and the boar collapse onto their side instead of sitting up facing camera, Tanglevolt lies on its side instead of flipping legs-up, and the faint-mid boar stays planted on its shadow

Give the homestead wall a textured wattle/plank infill with visible thickness and value variation (keep B's frame, cap and stone footing), and keep the craft panel at A's type size with single-line costs, more visible rows and teal controller-glyph prompts
